Quick answers

Do you board up before glass arrives?

Yes—security comes first. We secure the opening with plywood or polycarbonate, then measure for tempered or laminated replacement.

Which cities do you cover?

Major metros from Toronto and Vancouver to Calgary and Halifax. Open the Cities page or call 1-888-XXX-XXXX with your address.

What should I send when I call?

Street address, photos of the break, whether the door must latch tonight, and any property manager contact.

Emergency storefront glass, commercial doors, and board-up across Canada. One number for security tonight and measured glass tomorrow.
